dealSummary: Valar Atomics, a developer of small nuclear reactors to power data centers, is in talks to raise $1 billion at a $5 billion pre-money valuation led by Sequoia, The Information reported.
Miami-based RapidPulse, a developer of technology for treating acute ischemic stroke, raised a $48 million Series B led by Medtronic, TechWald Next and S3 Ventures.
San Francisco-based Sable, which builds AI to lead customer sales calls, raised a $45 million round led by Sequoia and 8VC.
Flow Labs, a geospatial AI company focused on traffic flow, raised approximately $14 million in a Series A led by AgFunder and Runa Capital, Axios reported.
San Diego-based Self Inspection, a developer of AI-powered vehicle-inspection software, raised $10 million led by Sheryl Sandberg’s Sandberg Bernthal Venture Partners.
leadInvestors: Sheryl Sandberg’s Sandberg Bernthal Venture Partners

dealSummary: Trellis Bioscience, a clinical-stage developer of monoclonal antibody treatments for antibiotic-resistant infections, raised a $9 million Series C from investors including New Science Ventures, Easton Capital and AMR Action Fund.
leadInvestors: New Science Ventures, Easton Capital, AMR Action Fund
